text.p: SA Telecommunications Inc said Tuesday it has acquired Addtel Communications Inc, a private switchless reseller of long-distance services.
Addtel, which is based in Glendale, Calif., had revenues of about $16.4 million for the year ended May 31, 1996, and about $18.3 million in revenues for the seven months ended December 31, 1996.
The acquisition was effective November 1. Terms were not disclosed.
Primarily all of Addtel's operating revenues are generated in California, SA Telecommunications said. Addtel also has operating authority in nine other states, it said.

SA Telecommunications said that the dollar amount of its consolidated gross margin is expected to increase as a result of the acquisition. However, it said its gross margin as a percentage of revenue will be adversely affected by the "blending of Addtel's lower margin wholesale revenue" into SA's total revenue base, it said.
